data.name: Ihtishaamun
data.gender_notes: Ihtishaamun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘Ihtasham’, meaning to be watchful, attentive, or protective. This name evokes a sense of responsibility and care, signifying a guardian or protector. The name Ihtishaamun carries the meaning “Watchfulness, vigilance, guardianship” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Ihtishaamun usually hope their child will grow to embody watchfulness, vigilance, guardianship and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who will grow up to be a watchful and caring individual, always vigilant to the needs of those around them.
data.etymology: Ihtishaamun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Watchfulness, vigilance, guardianship.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ihtishaamun total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: إحتشامون
in_arabic.meaning: إحتشامون يعني الوقار والتعظيم في المعاملة
in_arabic.long_meaning: إحتشامون هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'حشم' والذي يعني الوقار والتعظيم. يوحي الاسم بالاحترام والكرامة في التعامل مع الآخرين. في القرآن الكريم، لا يوجد ذكر صريح للاسم ولكن الجذر 'حشم' له دلالات على الستر والوقار.

in_urdu.name: احتسام
in_urdu.meaning: احتسام کا مطلب ہے احترام و توقیر
in_urdu.long_meaning: احتسام ایک عربی मूल کا نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے احترام و توقیر۔ یہ نام فرد کی شخصیت میں وقار اور احترام کی صفات کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے ثقافت میں، یہ نام احترام اور وقار کی اہمیت کو بیان کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: इहतिशामुन
in_hindi.meaning: इहतिशामुन का अर्थ है सम्मान और गरिमा
in_hindi.long_meaning: इहतिशामुन एक अरबी मूल का नाम है जिसका अर्थ है सम्मान और गरिमा। यह नाम व्यक्ति के चरित्र में गरिमा और सम्मान की विशेषताओं को दर्शाता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम सम्मान और गरिमा के महत्व को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: احتشامون
in_pashto.meaning: احتشامون د احترام او توقیر معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: احتشامون د عربي ريښې نوم دی چې د احترام او توقیر معنی لري. دا نوم د شخص په کرکټر کې د وقار او احترام ځانګړتیاوې څرګندوي. د افغان او پښتون دود، دا نوم د احترام او توقیر ارزښت څرګندوي.

in_english.name: Ihtishaamun
in_english.meaning: Ihtishaamun means dignity, respect, and grandeur
in_english.long_meaning: Ihtishaamun is derived from the Arabic root 'ḥ-sh-m' which signifies dignity, respect, and grandeur. The name implies a person of honor and dignity. In Islamic tradition, while the name is not directly mentioned in the Quran, its root has connotations of modesty and respect. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures to denote someone with a respectable and dignified personality.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: احتشامون

data.cultural_impact: The name "Ihtishaamun" holds a cultural significance in the Islamic community, as it encourages individuals to take on roles as civil protectors, guardians of community, or individuals who safeguard and preserve religious and cultural heritage. This concept aligns with the fundamental values and teachings of Islam, which emphasizes the importance of maintaining social cohesion and preserving community well-being, enjoining good and forbidding evil.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name "Ihtishaamun" carries a deeper meaning, representing the practice of exercising self-restraint and watchfulness over one’s own actions and intentions, serving as a reminder to remain mindful and protective of one’s faith and the faith of others. This concept is in line with the teachings of self-reflection and accountability found in Salaah (prayer), Zikr (remembrance of Allah), and Seerah (study of the Prophet’s life), which sets the foundation for a meaningful spiritual journey towards personal and collective enlightenment.
